description: Mini-OpenClaw - A lightweight, transparent AI Agent system built with Python (FastAPI + LangChain 1.x create_agent) and Next.js, featuring file-first memory, instruction-following Agent Skills, and an IDE-style three-column UI.

acceptanceCriteria: Create directories: backend/, backend/memory/, backend/memory/logs/, backend/sessions/, backend/skills/, backend/workspace/, backend/tools/, backend/graph/

Running `uvicorn backend.app:app --port 8002` starts the server successfully
